name: The Ruined Bloom
source: This story follows the journey of Yuu Kanata, an ordinary high school student, as he tries to protect his younger sister, Misaki Kanata, from a cruel world. Every choice you make will determine the fate of this family...
translation: 这个故事讲述了普通高中生优彼方的旅程，他试图保护他的妹妹美咲彼方免受残酷世界的侵害。你的每一个选择都将决定这个家庭的命运……
